g.text: 1. Function: two OPA1622, one per leg of the right channel of the 4.4 mm output; each half its own

g.desc: 1. Function: two OPA1622, one per leg of the right channel of the 4.4 mm output; each half its own

g.text: difference amplifier (R1 = R3 1.00 kΩ, R2 = R4 1.62 kΩ, gain 1.62, 100 pF across R2 and R4),

g.desc: difference amplifier (R1 = R3 1.00 kΩ, R2 = R4 1.62 kΩ, gain 1.62, 100 pF across R2 and R4),

g.text: feedback at the half's pin, 1.0 Ω ballast to the leg (ADR 0012; BOM v1 lines 19, 37, 107, 108).

g.desc: feedback at the half's pin, 1.0 Ω ballast to the leg (ADR 0012; BOM v1 lines 19, 37, 107, 108).

g.text: 2. Absent state: HPA_BAL_EN pulled down on the host side: shutdown. A disabled output is not

g.desc: 2. Absent state: HPA_BAL_EN pulled down on the host side: shutdown. A disabled output is not

g.text: high-impedance: never fitted but unpowered while the other stage plays (feature blocks #33-34);

g.desc: high-impedance: never fitted but unpowered while the other stage plays (feature blocks #33-34);

g.text: left off only with its jack, as one output module (blk.hp-out-se, -bal: feature blocks #51-52).

g.desc: left off only with its jack, as one output module (blk.hp-out-se, -bal: feature blocks #51-52).

g.text: 3. R4 returns to ground; the jack's ground pin joins it at the jack.

g.desc: 3. R4 returns to ground; the jack's ground pin joins it at the jack.

g.text: 4. Thermal pad (EP) to V- (PCB-A-08). Halves of a package symmetric, legs symmetric (PCB-A-09, -10).

g.desc: 4. Thermal pad (EP) to V- (PCB-A-08). Halves of a package symmetric, legs symmetric (PCB-A-09, -10).

g.text: 5. Rails from blk.hpa-bal, after links H20 #9 and #10 (power tree §4.12).

g.desc: 5. Rails from blk.hpa-bal, after links H20 #9 and #10 (power tree §4.12).

g.text: 6. Unless noted: network resistors 0.1 % 0603 thin film, network capacitors C0G 50 V 0603;

g.desc: 6. Unless noted: network resistors 0.1 % 0603 thin film, network capacitors C0G 50 V 0603;

g.text: ballast 1 % 0603; decoupling X7R 0402. Mute shunt footprints (BOM v1 line 100): open item.

g.desc: ballast 1 % 0603; decoupling X7R 0402. Mute shunt footprints (BOM v1 line 100): open item.
